arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Geller argued the Act applies to park concession contracts.
Mr. Elwood argued the Act does not apply to these contracts.
Mr. Elwood cited precedent against facial invalidation of regulations.
Mr. Geller cited 28 U.S.C. 1491(b) for district court jurisdiction.
